recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for this issue unless a future general editorial cleanup separately normalizes whitespace in NamingSystem.type display text.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive DSTU1 issue requested that Namespace.category display example values with commas, e.g. driver, provider, patient, bank, instead of vertical bars that made the free-text category look like an enumeration.
initial_application: The Jira-commented SVN revision is represented by git commit 94cb5ef302ecf451a2b7863b4b43e709f3614410, which changed the old NamingSystem category short description from "driver | provider | patient | bank" to comma-separated example wording.
additional_context: The current resource source has evolved to NamingSystem.type, and source/fhir.ini actively includes namingsystem=NamingSystem. Current StructureDefinition and search-parameter source both use comma-separated examples, repository-wide source search found no remaining vertical-bar driver/provider/patient/bank example, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting later discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current source already satisfies the issue. The remaining double spaces in the historical short text do not recreate the enumeration ambiguity and do not justify a source-changing reconciliation commit.
